target_include_directories(crypto
    PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.. ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../providers/implementations/include
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../providers/common/include
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../providers/fips/include
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/include/>
           $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>)
# Only the generated DER sources use this include path. It has generic header names.
file(GLOB OPENSSL_DER_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../providers/common/der/*.c)
set_source_files_properties(${OPENSSL_DER_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
    INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../providers/common/include/prov)

# STATIC_LEGACY links the legacy provider into libcrypto, as in the upstream static build.
# OPENSSLDIR and MODULESDIR are the upstream Unix defaults. This build has no loadable modules.
target_compile_definitions(crypto PRIVATE STATIC_LEGACY OPENSSLDIR="/usr/local/ssl" MODULESDIR="/usr/local/lib/ossl-modules")
if (WIN32)
    # The same defines as the upstream Windows configurations.
    target_compile_definitions(crypto PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN=1 UNICODE _UNICODE _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE _WINSOCK_DEPRECATED_NO_WARNINGS=1)
    target_link_libraries(crypto PUBLIC ws2_32 crypt32 advapi32 user32 bcrypt)
else ()
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(crypto PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
endif ()
